changelog: New parent web app design, in line with the Cucù website (Fraunces and Figtree fonts, warm grey and pastel palette, hand-made shapes), built for phones first: bottom navigation, full-page character details, bottom sheets instead of browser pop-ups, undo for deleted figurines and episodes, clear upload errors, free disk space shown before uploading. Fonts and logo are now served by the device itself, so the page looks right on the emergency hotspot too.
